title: The Trojan horse in the classroom
discussion_signal: The discussion of PISA 2025 presents purposeful, moderate AI use and critical assessment skills as potentially supportive of learning, while unstructured drafting, excessive device use, and unequal access to AI literacy can weaken learning and widen digital gaps.
linked_research_question: How do learning decline, socioeconomic gaps, digital distraction, and purposeful AI use interact in the future-readiness of students?
limits: The post summarizes PISA findings and does not establish causal effects of AI use
International averages conceal school and country differences
The discussion is secondary interpretation rather than raw student testimony
